id: AT-STATE-ROOT-07 (state-root: migrate leaves out the pin and lineage of a session that still runs, and copies them once it ended)
note: STATE-ROOT (0.1.2): a session of an older version still writes its pin and lineage in the old handoff root, and the new root's file is read first, so a copy made while it runs would hide its later changes. migrate leaves out the pin (.sessions/<sid>.json) and lineage (.sessions/<sid>.lineage.json) of every session with a live record in the old root's .sessions/by-pid (the pid runs with the recorded start time, no ended- twin), lists them by session and ends by asking for a rerun once those sessions end; the rerun copies them as new files, and locate then reads the session's newest pin. begin's re-pin check reads a live session's pin folder recorded under the removed old root as its copy under the new root.
